senses.gloss:
mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Bland, soft, unctuous, smooth.
2 Thick, bulky, gross.
n. (-नं)
1 Thickness, grossness, massiveness.
2 Idleness, sloth.
3 Echo.
E.
स्त्यै to sound, क्त aff.

m. (-नः)
1 A thief.
2 Amṛta, nectar.
E.
स्त्यै to sound, &c., इनच् Uṇādi aff.

r. 1st cl. (स्त्यायति)
1 To sound.
2 To collect, to crowd; also ष्ट्यै.
